## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, customer data or confidential information
- [ ] I have the right to share these questions and answers, and I named the source and licence below
- [ ] For a new benchmark: the folder has `competition.yaml`, `pages/overview.md`, `terms.md`, `logo.png`, `ingestion_program/`, `scoring_program/`, `phase/input_data/` and `phase/reference_data/`
- [ ] The scorer is explained in `pages/overview.md` in plain words
- [ ] I checked the answers are correct
- [ ] `pages/overview.md` says what the benchmark does not cover
